verdict.rationale: Skyvern's core pitch is an AI-powered browser agent that maps visual elements to actions on unseen sites without custom code, implying task instructions can be given via natural-language prompts, and it's described as an LLM-driven automation platform (llms.txt, GitHub). However, no evidence pack item explicitly shows a natural-language 'tell it what to do' interface/prompt example, nor community confirmation of NL command usability (community threads focus on cost/reliability, not the NL interface itself). Missing for 10: an explicit documented example of issuing tasks via free-form natural language, independent hands-on confirmation that arbitrary NL instructions work reliably.
